title: triticum aestivum f. albidum
intro: Triticum aestivum f. albidum, commonly known as white wheat, is a variant of the bread wheat plant. It is a type of hexaploid wheat that has been found to possess various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of white wheat include its ability to act as a natural anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis and diabetes. The bioactive constituents of white wheat include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
